comment: Deployment descriptor. Every component maps 1:1 to a module that already runs locally; nothing here is a re-implementation.

functions.description: Serves the FastAPI application. The same ASGI app object used locally.

functions.name: cip_refresh

buckets.description: NDJSON landing zone and generated exports.
